principle: A recognizable expectation, followed by a concrete departure from it. Stop when the surprise lands.
provenance: Hand-curated responses to the latest user feedback. These are proposals, not pipeline generations; only Carpenter is newly approved. The fission line was already approved in an earlier review.

harrison.feedback: User is happy with the compass hook. Preserve the exact wording.

musa.feedback: The fact is clear but lacks a felt contrast in scale: an individual spending money versus affecting the city’s gold market. Do not invent a rule that one person cannot move a market.

proposals.text: Mansa Musa didn’t just spend a fortune in Cairo—he reportedly changed what gold was worth there for more than a decade.
proposals.note: Spending a fortune is the expectation; changing the value of gold is the turn. The existing account’s uncertainty and duration remain.

proposals.text: Cairo’s gold market reportedly took more than a decade to recover from one visitor’s spending.
proposals.note: City-wide market and decade-long aftermath versus one visitor. The following prose must immediately identify Musa and his party.

silk-roads.feedback: A merchant turning back supplies neither scope nor significance. The opening needs the scale and interests of the wider network.

proposals.text: Silk linked Rome and China—but the empire between them reportedly tried to stop the two from making direct contact.
proposals.note: New opening direction, grounded in the Chinese account of Parthian silk interests. It requires a broader opening section before the fourth-century letters; it is not a drop-in replacement for the existing body.

leiden.feedback: An ordinary wire losing energy as heat is clear, but does not create enough surprise and takes too long. Lead with what superconductivity lets a current do.

proposals.text: Electricity can keep circulating after you disconnect the power—if its loop of wire is cold enough.
proposals.note: The wire must be a suitable superconductor and remain within its operating limits. The body must explain the closed loop and that cooling can require energy; no claim of free power or a measured duration.

meitner.feedback: The electricity/disbelieving-scientists version is wordy. The exile and letter create distracting questions. Return to the earlier approved discovery-scale sentence.

proposals.text: The discovery that opened the nuclear age started with an accident.
proposals.note: Previously approved wording, recommended for restoration here. Accident means an unexpected result during deliberate research, not a spill or equipment failure.

bell.feedback: Pre-existing properties and locality are too abstract for the opening. Start with an understandable ordinary situation behaving unexpectedly.

proposals.text: Two players who cannot communicate can win a guessing game more often with quantum particles than with any shared plan alone.
proposals.note: An illustration using the CHSH game, not a claim that Clauser ran a literal game. Shared entanglement beats the classical limit on average; it does not guarantee wins or let either player send a message. The body must introduce the game and then connect it to Bell tests.
